source_text: Videamus inflationem eius ut eam caveamus. Stabiles perseveremus habentes aedificium super petram Iesum Christum, cui gloria. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Let us see its inflation so that we may beware of it. Let us persevere stable having a building upon the rock Jesus Christ, to whom be glory. Amen.
pass_b_english: Beware pride’s swelling. Stand firm with a house [[built on the rock >> Bible:Matthew 7:24]] — Jesus Christ, to whom be glory. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Isaiah homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
